title.en: Shiroi Kekkon kara Sannen. Danna-sama, Watashi to Rien shite kudasai

altTitles.ja: 白い結婚から三年。旦那様、私と離縁してください

altTitles.en: after three years of a loveless marriage… may i request a divorce my lord

description.en:
“My Lord… Please, Divorce Me.”

Liz, the daughter of a poor baron family, was married off to a count’s household as payment for her father’s debts.
But instead of a dignified life, she found herself in a living hell—working tirelessly like a servant, while her husband openly pampered his mistress before her very eyes.

Not only did he neglect her, but he also followed his lover’s every whim, squandering the family’s fortune on her indulgences, pushing the once-noble house into steady decline.
One by one, the servants left, and Liz—quietly enduring it all—began to crumble.

Until one pivotal moment, when she could no longer take it.
She made up her mind:
To get a divorce—peacefully.

With the help of Alwin, a clever and kind young advisor she met by chance, Liz begins to strategically plan her separation.

But the road to freedom isn’t easy. She must:
    •    Gather solid proof of her husband’s infidelity to persuade the High Priest to grant the divorce.
    •    Save up enough money to start a new life on her own.

Armed with experience, sharp wit, and unwavering patience, Liz prepares for her final battle—to free herself from a soul-crushing marriage and reclaim her future.

This divorce isn’t an end—
It’s the beginning of her fight to live again.
Collect the evidence. Plan wisely.
Buy back your life.
